title: Male Bonding
description: MALE BONDING comes into play in this Boris Vallejo poster (front) as Luke Skywalker astride a Tauntaun and Han Solo with gun drawn "race across the windswept ice fields of Hoth to warn the rebels" of the Imperial onslaught. Not quite the way it happened in THE EMPlRE STRIKES BACK, but that's artistic licence. The chilling scene (back) on Bespin shows Han frozen in carbonite with our heroes powerless to save him—until the next film.
